What we are building

Founding Stage
  • Northern Hub: Warsaw & Winona Lake community network
  • Central Hub: Fishers & Hamilton County regional connection
  • County-by-County: Local connections in every part of Indiana
  • Action-Oriented: Practical ways to learn, serve, and lead locally
Our Mission

Connect locally. Lead confidently.

Strong communities are built by people who show up, stay informed, and work together.

NEW AGE Grassroots makes it easier for Hoosiers to connect with one another, understand local issues, and take meaningful civic action. We are starting with two hubs and growing county by county.

Starting small. Growing statewide.

We are in our launch phase, building real relationships and practical local opportunities before expanding.

Civic Participation First

Equipping individuals to attend county council hearings, participate in school boards, and vote with well-informed convictions.

Substantive Political Education

Hosting thoughtful forums, policy briefings, and constitutional discussions rooted in Hoosier economic realism.

All 92 Counties Matter

Ensuring that rural townships, suburban corridors, and metropolitan centers alike have an active, organized conservative voice.

What We Do

Four ways to get involved

Choose the path that fits you. Start where you are and grow from there.

Civic Engagement

Demystifying state and local government. We teach residents how policy is made at the Statehouse and how to engage effectively in township and municipal decisions.

  • Local legislative monitoring
  • Public testimony workshops
  • Nonpartisan voter turnout support

Leadership Development

Preparing the next generation of conservative civic leaders, campaign managers, board members, and public servants through practical mentoring.

  • Campaign mechanics training
  • Communications & speechcraft
  • Advisory board appointments

Community Involvement

True conservatism begins with neighborly service. We emphasize hands-on volunteer initiatives, community cleanups, and local charity assistance.

  • Hoosier service projects
  • Small business roundtable spotlights
  • Faith & civic cooperation

Statewide Networking

Bridging the geographical divide between Northern, Central, and Southern Indiana to build an enduring network of like-minded patriots.

  • Regional cross-county meetups
  • Young professional exchanges
  • Direct county liaison channels
Statewide Presence

One network. All 92 counties.

We are starting in Kosciusko and Hamilton counties and welcoming local connectors from every part of Indiana.

About NEW AGE Grassroots

Built by Hoosiers.

A local-first network helping Hoosiers connect, serve, and lead.

Our Founding Story

Two communities. One statewide vision.

NEW AGE Grassroots began with two Hoosiers who wanted stronger local connections between elections.

Our starting points are Warsaw / Winona Lake and Fishers.

The goal: a practical, county-by-county network for Hoosiers who want to make a difference.
